items.summary: Add a public Motoko backend method to create a new comment list. It must accept a list name, persist the new list in stable/mutable storage, and return a success or error result. The frontend AdminComments view must be wired to call this method so that creating a list no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

Add a public Motoko backend method to create/record an app event. It must accept the required event fields (e.g., app name, date/usernames payload), persist the event in stable storage, and return a result. The frontend AdminLiveList view must be wired to call this method so that creating an app event no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

Add a public Motoko backend method to set and store the access key. It must accept a text key, persist it in stable/mutable state, and return a confirmation. The frontend AdminSettings view must be wired to call this method so that setting the access key no longer returns 'backend does not support'.

Add a public Motoko backend method to upload and store music (URL or binary blob). It must accept the music data/URL and any relevant metadata, persist it in stable storage, and return a result. The frontend AdminSettings (background music upload) and any relevant upload views must be wired to call this method so that uploading music no longer returns 'backend does not support'.
